edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Jazz on the Alley wraps its season Thursday with the Alamo Band on Ram Cat Alley, Adam Hunter brings stand-up to Walhalla PAC Friday, and both lakeside breweries run music straight through a Halloween weekend that also fills downtown Seneca and Westminster's Main Street with trick-or-treaters.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley: Alamo Band — the season finale
events.body: The last Thursday of this year's run brings the Alamo Band to Ram Cat Alley. Catch it now — the next one's not until spring.
events.note: Free · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca · happy hour 5:30pm, music 7–9pm
events.source: City of Seneca · Visit Oconee SC

events.title: Adam Hunter Comedy Club at Walhalla PAC
events.body: The crowd-work comedian and Gutfeld! writer headlines the Performing Arts Center's restored civic auditorium downtown.
events.note: $32–$52 · 7:30pm · Walhalla Performing Arts Center, 101 E. N. Broad St.

events.title: Friday night, two breweries: Andrew Crocker and Brown Mountain Lightning Bugs
events.body: Keowee Brewing has Andrew Crocker playing downtown Seneca; across the water, Jocassee Valley Brewing has Brown Mountain Lightning Bugs with MAJOES' Filipino food truck out front.
events.note: Free · Both start 6:30pm · Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St., Seneca & Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem
events.source: Keowee Brewing · Jocassee Valley Brewing · Visit Oconee SC

events.title: Halloween on the Green
events.body: Downtown Seneca's trick-or-treating and costume contest for kids 12 and under, rain or shine.

events.title: Boo on Main
events.body: Westminster's Main Street Halloween event — costumes encouraged. The city hadn't posted a start time when we checked, so confirm before you go.
events.note: Free · Main Street, Westminster · time not yet posted
events.source: City of Westminster · Visit Oconee SC

events.title: Halloween night, two breweries: The Dead Ringers and a Samhain evening
events.body: Keowee Brewing throws Halloween live music with The Dead Ringers; Jocassee Valley Brewing marks Samhain with Celtic music from Allen & Goers and Iron Oak Barn's food out front.
events.note: Free · Both start 6:30pm · Keowee Brewing, Seneca & Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem
events.source: Keowee Brewing · Jocassee Valley Brewing · Visit Oconee SC

events.title: Jocassee Valley Brewing: Suze Luna & Dick Wells
events.body: An afternoon set closes out the weekend, Farm to Fire Fermentery's food truck back for the day.
events.note: Free · Music at 4pm · open 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

plan.title: Catch the last Jazz on the Alley of the season
plan.body: The Alamo Band plays Ram Cat Alley at 7pm, happy hour from 5:30. Grab dinner downtown before the music starts.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: Launch early, before Halloween takes over both towns
plan.body: Halloween on the Green, Boo on Main, and both breweries' music all land Saturday evening. Get on the water in the morning while the ramps are quiet.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Check the lake level before Jocassee Valley's Sunday set
plan.body: Suze Luna & Dick Wells play at 4pm. See where Keowee and Jocassee stand before you head out for the afternoon.
plan.label: Check the lake level →
